name: nanoclaw
description: A lightweight alternative to OpenClaw that runs in containers for security. Connects to WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, Discord, Gmail and other messaging apps,, has memory, scheduled jobs, and runs directly on Anthropic's Agents SDK
summary: 轻量级替代 OpenClaw，容器运行以保障安全。连接 WhatsApp、Telegram、Slack、Discord 及 Gmail 等消息应用，具备记忆功能，支持定时任务，并直接运行在 Anthropic 的 Agents SDK 上
categoryDescription: 文档、表格、邮件、日历、笔记与个人生产力
howToUse: 阅读仓库 README 的安装要求，将 Skill、插件或工具接入对应环境，再按文档触发工作流。
installCommand:
git clone https://github.com/nanocoai/nanoclaw.git nanoclaw-v2
cd nanoclaw-v2
bash nanoclaw.sh
